yellow.use: primary button background and the app header behind the PostFinance logo (with text.primary, 11.1:1). Never text, never an icon on white.

petrol.use: links, secondary buttons, chips, marker icon, time-jump background (9.7:1 on white)

grapefruit.use: action-tone border and icon only (3.1:1, non-text). Text uses semantic.urgentText.

petrolLight.use: light teal: non-recurring essentials in spending charts, with a 1px petrol outline (2.1:1 on white). Never text.

red.use: PostFinance alert red: could-cut-back spending in charts, with white text or icons (5.3:1).
